title: Design System: Indra OCR — Finding Aid

paper.purpose: Page ground: body, header, footer, scrollbar track.

panel.purpose: Raised-by-tone surfaces: accession panel, claim stubs.

sheet.purpose: Working surfaces: drop field, preview figures.

ink-soft.purpose: Secondary text: small-caps labels, section heads, ledger copy, footer row, PROCESSING stamp.

ink-faint.purpose: Tertiary text: hints, placeholders, empty states, call numbers; disabled button background.

rule.purpose: Primary hairlines: header/footer double rules, panel and stub borders, scrollbar thumb, dashed drop border.

rule-soft.purpose: Secondary hairlines: section-head leader lines, ledger top border, preview caption divider.

vermilion.purpose: The single accent: stamp states, primary button, links, focus outline, caret, checked checkbox.

vermilion-wash.purpose: Accent at rest: text selection background, drop field drag-over fill.

display.purpose: Masthead h1 only — Libre Caslon Display, the one line of repository formality.

body.purpose: All interface prose, checkbox labels (14.5px), hints and descriptions (12px).

label.purpose: Tracked small caps: field labels, section heads (12px/0.2em), claim-stub kinds, preview captions, footer row (0.16em), meta rule (0.22em).

mono.purpose: Anything countable or status-bearing: ledger line (tabular-nums), filenames (15px), preview code (13px, JSON 12px).

stamp.purpose: Rubber-stamp state labels: bold Courier, wide 0.22em tracking, uppercase, inside a bordered rotated box.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Stamp press: from rotate(-8deg) scale(1.7) opacity 0 to rotate(-2.5deg) scale(1) opacity 1. Overshoot ease gives the stamp a physical thunk.

motion.name: drop-field-hover
motion.purpose: Drop field border/background transition on hover and drag-over.

motion.name: button-background
motion.purpose: Primary button hover color shift vermilion to vermilion-deep.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global collapse — stamp lands instantly, rotation and final state preserved.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single committing action (BEGIN CONVERSION / PROCESSING…).

components.name: Drop Field
components.description: Ruled paper form line awaiting a document; drag-over commits it in vermilion wash.

components.name: Accession Stamp
components.description: Signature component: state labels pressed on as a slightly crooked rubber stamp.

components.name: Ledger Line
components.description: Live monospace status row under the form: stage, elapsed time, call number.
components.html: ProcessingProcessing, elapsed 00:12.4. First accession downloads ~18 MB models (one time).

components.name: Claim Stub
components.description: Result download card: kind label, mono download link, one-line description.
components.html: Claim stub — oneMarkdown (.md)Structured text: headings, lists, tables.

components.name: Preview Panel
components.description: Ruled reading column for converted output; caption divided from code by a soft hairline.

narrative.northStar: Finding Aid — the Archival Accession Desk
narrative.overview:
OCR intake is staged as archival accession: every document that arrives is accessioned, stamped, and served from a claim desk. The page reads like a repository reading room — bone paper ground, engraving ink, hairline rules, tracked small-caps labels — not like a developer tool. It explicitly refuses the category default: the dark dev-tool card, the system-font stack, the spinner status line.

Density is form-like and centered: a single 760px column carries an accession panel whose fields are ruled like paper form lines, a live monospace ledger line underneath, then claim stubs and ruled reading columns for results. The memorable moment is the stamp — states press themselves onto the page (ACCESSIONED → PROCESSING → DIGITIZED) over a live monospace ledger counting pages and seconds.

One accent does all the committing. Everything else is warm neutral paper, ink, and rule tones, held apart by hairlines rather than depth. All fonts are self-hosted OFL Google Fonts (Libre Caslon Display, Archivo, Courier Prime).
keyCharacteristics: Archival, printed, ruled — flat surfaces separated by hairlines, never by glass or glow.
Three-voice type: Caslon for the masthead only, Archivo for interface prose and labels, Courier Prime for anything countable or status-bearing.
Vermilion as the single committed accent: stamps, primary action, links, errors.
Motion is a physical press, not a digital fade; reduced-motion collapses it to instant.

rules.name: The Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears only where the system commits or signals: stamps, the primary button, links, focus, errors. Its rarity against bone paper is the point; if a screen has more than one vermilion element beyond action/error/active-state, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tone-Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is expressed only by the paper → panel → sheet ladder plus hairlines (#F4EFE4 → #FBF8F1 → #FFFFFF). Never by shadow.

rules.name: The Data Rule
rules.body: Anything countable, status-bearing, or identifying — elapsed time, call numbers, filenames, file contents — is Courier Prime. Prose is Archivo. Display type never leaves the masthead.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface is a flat tone with a hairline edge. If something needs to feel raised, move it one step up the tone ladder (#F4EFE4 → #FBF8F1 → #FFFFFF); never add a shadow.

dos: Do keep the page on the tone ladder #F4EFE4 → #FBF8F1 → #FFFFFF and separate surfaces with 1px solid #C9BFA9 hairlines.
Do reserve #C8371E for stamps, the primary button, links, focus rings, checked checkboxes, and errors — hover states step to #A82C16, drag-over/idle washes use #F6E4DC.
Do set every label, section head, caption, and footer row as Archivo 600 11–12px, uppercase, tracked 0.16em–0.22em, in ink-soft.
Do set every number, status, filename, call number, and code block in Courier Prime with tabular-nums where values update live.
Do use square corners (0px) everywhere except the button (2px) and the stamp (3px).
Do press new stamps with the press keyframe (-8deg/1.7 → -2.5deg/1, 0.5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2)) and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add shadows, glass, blur, or glow — depth is tone + hairline only.
Don't use a spinner or generic progress bar for status; states are stamps plus a monospace ledger line.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, a dark-mode dev-tool surface, or system-font defaults.
Don't put display Caslon anywhere except the masthead h1.
Don't use vermilion for decorative emphasis, long text, or large fills — its rarity is the system.
